notes.title: Patch 1.1 - 241224
notes.content:
Playlist #7 (Endless mode) added.
- Now you can go up buildings endlessly and kill  enemies.

In Playlist #7, a new rule is added.
- Only standard boombox (including Meet the T.Rock) is available.
- You will no longer get skill gauge by defeating enemies.
- When you kill enemies, enemies drop a weapon or skill with a certain probability.
- Dropped weapons or skills can be acquired by pressing the interaction key.

Language
- Added Spanish and Russian language support

UI
- Added a button that shows all comics after you've cleared the game.

Weapons And Skills
- Added 1 weapon and 1 skill that only appears in endless mode.

Boss
- Added 1 Boss that only appears in endless mode.

Achievements
- Added 4 endless mode related achievements.

The First Shot
- Some of the symbols for player guidance have been modified.

Deadline Disco & Last Dance
- Fixed an issue that characters might collide when passing through enemy's spawn location.

We Will T.Rock You
- Enemy spawn locations are now indicated before enemies appear.
- Changed the color of waves that appear when breaking boss patterns.

Blindian Rhapsody
- Enemy spawn locations are now indicated before enemies appear.

notes.title: Hotfix - 241219
notes.content:
We've made the following changes:

UI
- Added a Quit Game button in main menu
- Changed the size of skill icons and crosshair
- Added animation for skill icons when skills become available
- Fixed display issues occurring in certain resolutions and languages

Skill Related
- Fixed a bug where melee kill with FAST & FURIOUS Boombox adds 2.5 charge instead of 2

Stage 'Get Ready for Work'
- Fixed an issue where enemies can pass through some obstacles.

Stage 'Deadline Disco'
- The difficulty of the stage has been lowered.
- Fixed an issue that players can enter the enemy spawn location.

Stage 'Ox Head'
- Changed stage and lowered the overall difficulty.

Stage 'Last Dance'
- Fixed an issue that players can enter the enemy spawn location.

Stage 'We Will T.Rock You'
- Fixed an issue where the game occasionally wouldn't progress to the next phase
- The Base Boss's speakers can no longer be destroyed
- Fixed the position of Guitar Boss's guitar strings

Stage 'Blindian Rhapsody'
- Bullets no longer penetrate the Band Boss barrier
- Missiles are no longer destroyed by the Band Boss barrier

Misc.
- Playlist #7 will be added. Please look forward to it!
